title: Endpoint estimates for Stein's purely quadratic Carleson operator
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of four principal endpoint assertions from Fragkos, Krause, and Lacey's Endpoint Estimates for Stein's Purely Quadratic Carleson Operator: two failures of modular estimates below t log₂ t, a full-modulation L log L endpoint estimate, and a lacunary L (log₂ L)² log₄ L endpoint estimate.

informal.QuadraticCarleson.StatementSurface.Paper: Lacunary purely quadratic modulation fails modular estimates below the specified iterated-logarithmic threshold.
Full purely quadratic modulation fails modular estimates below the specified iterated-logarithmic threshold.
The full-modulation operator satisfies the L log L endpoint estimate.
The lacunary operator satisfies the L (log₂ L)² log₄ L endpoint estimate.
